column2: By the troubled year 316 After Cataclysm, the Empire remained whole only in name, for Emperor Alexander had vanished after the Bralona Crisis and years have gone by without a ruling Emperor. In his absence, nobles ruled as sovereigns, merchant princes bent trade to their will, generals gathered loyal armies, and secretive sorcerers whispered of darker designs. Imperial banners still flew above city walls, but unity was a memory and intrigue now governed the realm where law and loyalty once stood.
